description: This file defines a Spring MVC REST controller for handling order-related HTTP requests in an e-commerce application. It includes endpoints for creating new orders, listing all orders, and listing orders for a specific customer, with logic for handling merchant store validation, localization, and order data transformation.

classes.name: OrderRESTController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing order operations such as creating and listing orders, with dependency injection for services and request mapping configurations.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new order, validating store information, processing customer info, populating the order model, and saving it.

methods.name: listOrders
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all orders for a store, with support for pagination, language selection, and error handling.

methods.name: listOrders
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list orders for a specific customer, validating customer and store info, with pagination and localization.
